prompt:
I work with a student named Jordan Lee who is preparing for the ACT. I need you to set up their complete prep file system under ~/act/.

Here is everything I know about Jordan:
- Test date is February 8, 2025 (roughly 13 weeks away from now in November 2024)
- Jordan wants to hit a composite score of 30
- Jordan studies about 8 hours per week
- Jordan has taken three practice tests so far — results are in ~/act/practice/
- Jordan is a high school junior
- Target colleges: University of Michigan, Ohio State University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, and Indiana University Bloomington. None of these require the Writing section. Additional notes are in ~/act/college_targets_raw.txt

I need you to:
1. Properly fill out Jordan's profile at ~/act/profile.md with all the planning details (the current file there is just an incomplete stub)
2. Update each of the four section files in ~/act/sections/ with a real analysis of Jordan's errors from the three practice tests — specifically documenting the reasons why questions were missed, not just the scores
3. Figure out Jordan's best possible score if the strongest individual section performance from each test were combined, and document this clearly
4. Update ~/act/feedback.md with concrete observations about what's working and what isn't
5. Add a note somewhere about Jordan's realistic chances at each college given the current trajectory

Please make sure the Writing section is handled correctly given Jordan's college targets.
